evals.prompt: Make this folder an RO-Crate: it contains data/results.csv. Author is me (I have no ORCID), licence CC BY 4.0, title 'Bird counts 2025'.
evals.expected_output: A valid 1.3 ro-crate-metadata.json with no invented identifiers.
expectations: Root has name, description, datePublished and license
Descriptor has a single conformsTo https://w3id.org/ro/crate/1.3
Author is a #local Person entity, no invented ORCID
data/results.csv is a File entity linked from the root hasPart

evals.prompt: Add a Process Run Crate record to this existing 1.2 crate for a run of ImageMagick that turned in.jpg into out.jpg.
evals.expected_output: Keeps version 1.2; adds SoftwareApplication, CreateAction and profile declaration on the root.
expectations: Does not silently change the declared version to 1.3
conformsTo of the Process Run Crate is on the root, with a Profile entity
CreateAction has instrument, object and result

evals.prompt: Write a detached RO-Crate for the catalogue record https://catalogue.example.org/events/7, which describes the workshop at https://events.example.com/workshop-2027 (schema.org Event, Bioschemas Course profile). The record has no licence.
evals.expected_output: Root Dataset = the record URL with publisher, datePublished and a text licence statement; the Event as mainEntity with its own type and Bioschemas profile conformsTo; no hasPart for the event.
expectations: The root data entity @id is the record URL and its @type is Dataset only, without Event or Course
The event is the root's mainEntity with its own schema.org type and the Bioschemas profile in its conformsTo
The event is not listed in hasPart
Does not choose a licence: uses a text statement or a TODO placeholder and says so
Uses a released Bioschemas profile URI (no -DRAFT)
